matthew.14.p1.b1.text: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard the reports about Jesus

matthew.14.p1.b2.text: This is John the Baptist; he has risen from the dead!

matthew.14.p1.b3.text: That is why miraculous powers are at work in him.

matthew.14.p2.b1.text: … on account of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife,

matthew.14.p2.b2.text: Now Herod had arrested John and bound him and put him in prison …

matthew.14.p2.b3.text: It is not lawful for you to have her.

matthew.14.p2.b4.text: Although Herod wanted to kill John, he was afraid of the people, because they regarded John as a prophet.

matthew.14.p3.b1.text: On Herod’s birthday, however, the daughter of Herodias danced before them and pleased Herod

matthew.14.p3.b2.text: so much that he promised with an oath to give to her whatever she asked.

matthew.14.p3.b3.text: Prompted by her mother, she said,

matthew.14.p3.b4.text: Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptist.

matthew.14.p4.b1.text: The king was grieved, but because of his oaths and his guests, he ordered that her wish be granted

matthew.14.p4.b2.text: and sent to have John beheaded in the prison.

matthew.14.p4.b3.text: John’s head was brought in on a platter and presented to the girl, who carried it to her mother.

matthew.14.p5.b1.text: Then John’s disciples came and took his body and buried it. And they went and informed Jesus.

matthew.14.p5.b2.text: When Jesus heard about John, He withdrew by boat privately to a solitary place.

matthew.14.p5.b3.text: But the crowds found out about it and followed Him on foot from the towns.

matthew.14.p6.b1.text: When He stepped ashore and saw a large crowd, He had compassion on them and healed their sick.

matthew.14.p6.b2.text: When evening came, the disciples came to Him and said,

matthew.14.p6.b3.text: This is a desolate place, and the hour is already late. Dismiss the crowds so they can go to the villages and buy themselves some food.

matthew.14.p6.b4.text: They do not need to go away, … You give them something to eat.

matthew.14.p7.b1.text: We have here only five loaves of bread and two fish,

matthew.14.p7.b3.text: And He directed the crowds to sit down on the grass.

matthew.14.p7.b4.text: Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, He spoke a blessing. Then He broke the loaves and gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the people.

matthew.14.p8.b1.text: They all ate and were satisfied,

matthew.14.p8.b2.text: and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.

matthew.14.p8.b3.text: About five thousand men were fed, in addition to women and children.

matthew.14.p9.b1.text: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go on ahead of Him to the other side, while He dismissed the crowds.

matthew.14.p9.b2.text: After He had sent them away, He went up on the mountain by Himself to pray.

matthew.14.p9.b3.text: When evening came, He was there alone,

matthew.14.p10.b1.text: but the boat was already far from land, buffeted by the waves because the wind was against it.

matthew.14.p10.b2.text: During the fourth watch of the night, Jesus went out to them, walking on the sea.

matthew.14.p10.b4.text: Take courage! It is I. Do not be afraid.

matthew.14.p11.b1.text: Lord, if it is You, … command me to come to You on the water.

matthew.14.p11.b3.text: Then Peter got down out of the boat, walked on the water, and came toward Jesus.

matthew.14.p12.b1.text: But when he saw the strength of the wind, he was afraid, and beginning to sink,

matthew.14.p12.b3.text: Immediately Jesus reached out His hand and took hold of Peter.

matthew.14.p12.b4.text: You of little faith, … why did you doubt?

matthew.14.p13.b1.text: And when they had climbed back into the boat, the wind died down.

matthew.14.p13.b2.text: Then those who were in the boat worshiped Him,

matthew.14.p13.b3.text: Truly You are the Son of God!

matthew.14.p14.b1.text: When they had crossed over, they landed at Gennesaret.

matthew.14.p14.b2.text: And when the men of that place recognized Jesus,

matthew.14.p14.b3.text: they sent word to all the surrounding region. People brought all the sick to Him

matthew.14.p15.b1.text: and begged Him just to let them touch the fringe of His cloak.

matthew.14.p15.b2.text: And all who touched Him were healed.
